title: Business bank account opening document request
use_when: Use when a client is opening a business bank account and needs to gather the documents banks commonly ask for.
note: Items are the SBA's list of the most common documents banks ask for; SBA says some banks may ask for more.

sba-bank.name: SBA, Launch your business: Open a business bank account (web page; no review date shown)

items.label: Employer Identification Number (EIN), or a Social Security number if the business is a sole proprietorship
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.
